ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AMD reaches $1 trillion market value as AI chip rally accelerates
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported AMD crossed the $1 trillion valuation threshold for the first time as investors rewarded its expanding role in AI computing and full-system strategy. AMD finished up about 10%; SOX rose about 4.3%.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: U.S. and China establish formal AI-safety dialogue and incident line
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington and Beijing agreed to an AI-safety dialogue, including an incident line, with senior officials due to meet again in Shenzhen in about two months. The tariff truce was also discussed, but no extension decision was announced.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple and Microsoft participate in broad megacap rebound; TSM ADR rises with chips
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple closed near its 52-week high, Microsoft rose 1.59%, and TSM ADR gained 2.39%. No new verified mega-cap earnings were released in the cutoff window; the move was primarily macro/AI-risk-on rather than an earnings reset.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI governance pressure remains active even as markets rally
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Spain's prime minister said the AI industry cannot be left to self-regulate and called for stronger public guardrails. The policy debate therefore remains a valuation risk even as AI capex expectations support semiconductors.

breaking_news.headline: Nasdaq closes at a record as AI optimism returns
breaking_news.market_impact: Nasdaq +2.26%, S&P 500 +1.49% and SOX about +4.3%. AMD nearly +10% and briefly/ultimately crossed the $1T valuation threshold.

breaking_news.headline: Oil and long yields retreat together
breaking_news.market_impact: WTI fell 4.86% to $95.43 and the U.S. 10-year yield fell below 5% to about 4.951%, removing two of the largest discount-rate pressures on growth stocks.

breaking_news.headline: Trump-Xi summit and U.S.-China AI dialogue move to center stage
breaking_news.market_impact: Thursday's summit is expected to cover trade, AI regulation and geopolitical issues. Chip export controls and supply-chain policy can quickly change assumptions for NVIDIA, AMD and TSMC.

earnings_summary.last_24h: No new verified U.S. mega-cap technology earnings were released in the cutoff window. Major guidance news included Societe Generale raising its 2029 profitability target and outlining EUR1.9B of gross savings, while Volkswagen continued restructuring after its recent profit warning.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: This week's U.S. company catalysts are consumer, housing and business-services heavy: AutoZone and KB Home on 9/22; General Mills, Cintas and Paychex on 9/23; Costco and Darden on 9/24. Costco remains the largest single-company earnings catalyst.

narration_points: 美股9月21日風險偏好快速回升：Nasdaq大漲2.26%創收盤新高，S&P 500漲1.49%，主因油價與10年債殖利率同步回落。
WTI跌4.86%到95.43美元，10年債殖利率降到約4.951%，兩個最直接的成長股折現率壓力同時緩解。
半導體是主角：SOX約漲4.3%，AMD收615.52美元大漲9.95%、市值跨越1兆美元，NVIDIA漲1.80%、TSM ADR漲2.39%。
AMD已來到目前52週區間約99.75%，接近616.68美元的區間高點，AI硬體強勢同時也代表估值敏感度升高。
美中已建立正式AI安全對話與事故熱線，並計畫約兩個月後在深圳再談；本週四Trump-Xi峰會仍是晶片政策最大事件風險。
9月22 session夜盤在05:00已結束，但06:00 cutoff前沒有取得可獨立驗證的最終OHLC與成交量，因此canonical保持null，只允許GitHub用相同session官方資料補值；夜盤OI本來就不公布。
今天10:00 ET先看Richmond Fed；9/23 Flash PMI、9/24初領失業金與新屋銷售、9/25耐久財接力。
財報則看9/22 AutoZone與KB Home、9/23 General Mills/Cintas/Paychex、9/24 Costco與Darden；Costco是本週最大單一公司催化。
